logp.method_description: Octanol-water partition coefficients. 500 mL aliquots of purified octanol and distilledwater reagents were thoroughly mixed in a 2 L separatory funnel to mutually saturatethe two phases. Triplicate 5 mL aliquots of standard solutions (20 μM) of MnL1-3, inwater-saturated octanol, was pipetted into 15 mL centrifuge tubes, and 5 mL of octanol-saturated water was added. The samples were shaken for 10 min and allowed to sit for18 hours. The samples were centrifuged for 30 min (3000g, 20° C) and 1.5 mL aliquotsfrom aqueous phase were carefully withdrawn and added into microcentrifuge tubes.The aliquots were spun for 30 min at 21000 rpm in a benchtop microcentrifuge and ali-quots for UV-Vis measurements were withdrawn carefully without touching octanol drop-lets on the surface. Concentrations of Mn-PDA complexes were quantified according totheir absorbance at 310 nm. Poct/wat was defined as ([complex]tot – [com-plex]wat)/([complex]wat), where [complex]tot was 10 μM.
